label: NHTSA vPIC (VIN decoder)
terms_note: US government (NHTSA) Product Information Catalog Vehicle Listing API: public, keyless. Missing decoded values mean NHTSA has no data, not that a feature is absent (API message).

decode_vin.note: Decode VIN (flat format), GET /vehicles/DecodeVinValues/{vin}?format=json. Partial VINs are accepted with '*' for unknown characters. raw.ErrorCode/ErrorText carry NHTSA's decode notes ('0 - VIN decoded clean'); a VIN whose make cannot be decoded is an error with NHTSA's ErrorText.

not_offered.me: Public API without accounts or keys (https://vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/api/).
not_offered.search_listings: vPIC is a vehicle specification catalogue; it has no vehicle-for-sale listings.
not_offered.get_listing: No listings in vPIC (specification data only).
not_offered.get_valuation: vPIC publishes no prices or valuations.
